name: chronokanban-collab-server
description: Self-hostable realtime sync server for ChronoKanban (Yjs over WebSocket, LevelDB-persisted).
comment: The server runs internally on one yjs (14, matching @y/websocket-server's pin) — the override forces y-leveldb onto it too, so there's a single yjs instance in the process (no instanceof/persistence breakage). Browser clients stay on yjs 13; they interoperate because Yjs's update binary format is stable across 13<->14.
